lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you know how he got her in the house?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Then just say that. I, I think you do but we'll go onto something else right now. Obviously you don't want to talk about that. Did you ride down in her jeep to that pit? Where he covered it up?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you ever go down there and look at it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What day was November 2nd? Do you know?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: That was the day you said you saw him with the key. You know what day it was?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Wednesday.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Let's go back to this key for second? Did you really see him drop that key?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he forgets to pick it up, is that what you told me?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: mm huh.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So that day he was getting a key out, why was he getting the key out?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz he was gonna get rid of it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well how could he get rid of that when he still had the truck, didn't he need the key for the truck..........

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you keep anything of hers at all?
